notes: HOTFIX for the v1.0.30 startup crash ('installs fine but never opens again'). v1.0.31 is crash-safe and self-diagnosing: crashes are captured from the first process step, and when a crash report is newer than the last successful open the app shows a 'Startup problem detected' screen BEFORE the main UI with Copy report / Reset app data / Continue anyway (a crash loop escalates to a full-screen gate). Startup hardened: engine coroutines and boot can no longer kill the process on a throw, the task-queue reconcile and project cleanup moved off the main thread, one malformed saved project no longer erases the whole project list, vault decrypt failures stay non-fatal. Regression tests load real v1.0.27-30-era payloads into the current loaders. Plus subtle Z.ai card motion polish (respects remove-animations). If v1.0.30 crashed for you: install over it and use Copy report on the screen that appears.
